cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car's back. Its return log needs mileage, fuel and driver. Give me the entries in order, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I mean the whole row. Start with mileage; don't substitute a damage report for the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means six flights down to check the dashboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll go and read it. Keep the row open; we aren't skipping an entry because the stairs are inconvenient.

reason: State the car has just returned and make dashboard readings the source of mileage and fuel. Preserve the full-row tactic and A's costly practical help without an imagined second book.
